name: Buscar usuário
query:
WITH matched AS (
  SELECT
    u.id,
    u.name,
    u.email,
    u.sector_id,
    s.name AS "sectorName",
    u.active,
    u.is_master,
    u.password_hash,
    CASE
      WHEN u.is_master = TRUE THEN (
        SELECT COALESCE(
          json_agg(p_all.code ORDER BY p_all.name),
          '[]'::json
        )
        FROM permissions p_all
        WHERE p_all.code <> 'gerenciar_tags'
      )
      ELSE COALESCE(
        (
          SELECT json_agg(p.code ORDER BY p.code)
          FROM user_permissions up
          JOIN permissions p ON p.id = up.permission_id
          WHERE up.user_id = u.id
            AND p.code <> 'gerenciar_tags'
        ),
        '[]'::json
      )
    END AS permissions
  FROM users u
  LEFT JOIN sectors s ON s.id = u.sector_id
  WHERE
    LOWER(u.email) = LOWER('{{ String($json.body.email || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}')
    AND u.active = true
    AND (
      (
        (
          u.password_hash LIKE '$2a$%'
          OR u.password_hash LIKE '$2b$%'
          OR u.password_hash LIKE '$2y$%'
        )
        AND u.password_hash = crypt(
          '{{ String($json.body.password || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
          u.password_hash
        )
      )
      OR (
        u.password_hash NOT LIKE '$2a$%'
        AND u.password_hash NOT LIKE '$2b$%'
        AND u.password_hash NOT LIKE '$2y$%'
        AND u.password_hash = '{{ String($json.body.password || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}'
      )
    )
  LIMIT 1
),
upgraded AS (
  UPDATE users u
  SET
    password_hash = crypt(
      '{{ String($("Webhook").item.json.body.password || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
      gen_salt('bf', 10)
    ),
    updated_at = NOW()
  FROM matched m
  WHERE u.id = m.id
    AND u.password_hash NOT LIKE '$2a$%'
    AND u.password_hash NOT LIKE '$2b$%'
    AND u.password_hash NOT LIKE '$2y$%'
  RETURNING u.id
)
SELECT
  m.id,
  m.name,
  m.email,
  m.sector_id,
  m."sectorName",
  m.active,
  m.is_master,
  m.permissions
FROM matched m
WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM upgraded) >= 0;

name: Criar sessão
query:
WITH cfg AS (
  SELECT
    (SELECT value FROM app_secrets WHERE key = 'session_ttl_seconds')::int AS ttl,
    (SELECT value FROM app_secrets WHERE key = 'jwt_hs256_secret') AS secret
),
sess AS (
  INSERT INTO user_sessions (user_id, expires_at, ip_address, user_agent)
  VALUES (
    '{{ $json.id }}'::uuid,
    NOW() + make_interval(secs => (SELECT ttl FROM cfg)),
    NULLIF('{{ String(($('Normalizar request').first().json.headers['x-real-ip'] || '')).replace(/'/g, "''") }}', ''),
    NULLIF('{{ String(($('Normalizar request').first().json.headers['user-agent'] || '')).replace(/'/g, "''") }}', '')
  )
  RETURNING id, token_id, created_at, expires_at
)
SELECT
  s.id AS "sessionId",
  s.token_id AS "tokenId",
  s.created_at AS "issuedAt",
  s.expires_at AS "expiresAt",
  (SELECT secret FROM cfg) AS "jwtSecret"
FROM sess s;
